messages:
pagerduty-bot: ALERT: cache_surge_prod_west1 triggered — prefix hit-rate drop >45% and upstream 5xx increase across generation endpoints. Paging on-call.

alex.m: paging — seeing a simultaneous drop in prefix hits for customer and product prefixes. Latency up ~300ms p95 and small burst of 502s. tagging @maya for on-call

maya: taking it. which regions and clusters impacted?

sam: confirmed prod-west1 primary and replica affected. Replica lag ~25s. Graph: prefix_hit_rate 0.88 -> 0.34 at 16:12:04Z.

opsbot: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-57. Severity P2. Runbook: cache-miss-surge. Pager: maya.

alex.m: customer impact: a subset of customers saw timeouts and degraded throughput. CS flagged customer-alpha, customer-beta.

cust-success-bot: Customer-alpha reported repeated timeouts starting ~16:13. Ticket #INC-ALPHA-83 opened.

maya: immediate mitigation plan: 1) flip prefix-sync migration flag to stop TTL migration flow 2) enable temporary TTL override to 90s for affected namespaces 3) start rewarm for top hot prefixes 4) collect logs and timeline. Doing flag flip now.

jen: deploy bot shows prefix-sync v2.14 deployed at 16:10:12Z with migration=true. No canary alerts. Pulling deploy logs.

jen: deploy log snippet:
```
2026-03-15T16:10:12Z deploy prefix-sync v2.14 success canary=4/4
config: enable_migration_flow=true
notes: new-ttl-behavior
```

sam: infra logs show a TTL push burst at 16:11:58Z where ttl field was absent for many prefixes and ended up serialized as 0 in downstream store.

alex.m: candidate causes off the top:
- H1: migration flow treats missing ttl as zero -> immediate eviction
- H2: autoscaler scaled down nodes after eviction -> capacity drop and further misses
- H3: simultaneous rewarms overloaded backend causing transient failures

ricardo: autoscaler dump shows aggressive scale-down between 16:12 and 16:14:
```
2026-03-15T16:12:30Z autoscaler INFO scale_down delta=-18 reason=low_residency
2026-03-15T16:13:50Z autoscaler WARN rapid_shrink threshold_exceeded
```

maya: flipping migration flag off (quick toggle) to stop any further zero-ttl writes.

jen: flipped migration flag at 16:14:05Z. Confirmed via infra API.

maya: patching a temporary override to set ttl=90 for selectors customer:* and product:* to give time for rewarm. Applying now:
```
# one-off: prefix override
kubectl -n prod-west1 apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: config/v1
kind: PrefixOverride
metadata:
  labels:
    emergency: true
spec:
  selector: 'prefix in ("customer:*","product:*")'
  ttl: 90
EOF
```

sam: override applied at 16:15:02Z. Monitoring hit-rates. early signs of recovery for product:rec model from 0.22 -> 0.6 by 16:17.

alex.m: starting mass rewarm for top 40 prefixes now to repopulate caches. Kicking rewarm job.

opsbot: Action logged: rewarm-job started by maya at 16:16:12Z targets=top40prefixes.

maya: also enabling KV reuse grace window (kv.reuse.grace=12s) to reduce thrash while rewarm runs.

jen: toggled kv.reuse.grace at 16:16:40Z.

sam: attaching logs: prefix-sync.log excerpt shows zero-ttl pushes: https://logs.redwood.internal/INC-2026-0315-57/prefix-sync.log
jen: deploy logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/INC-2026-0315-57/deploy.log
ricardo: autoscaler dump: https://logs.redwood.internal/INC-2026-0315-57/autoscaler.dump

alex.m: collecting timeline note: TTL push spike at 16:11:58Z, autoscaler scale-down at 16:12:30Z, migration flag flip at 16:14:05Z, override applied 16:15:02Z, rewarm started 16:16:12Z.

jen: quick test in staging to reproduce: toggled migration flag in staging and saw missing ttl serialized as 0 under current serializer; will prepare a safe fix to treat absent field as "inherit" not zero.

ricardo: initial root-cause hypothesis: prefix-sync migration flow wrote unset ttls as 0 (H1) causing immediate evictions; autoscaler interpreted low residency and aggressively scaled down (H2), amplifying misses. We'll validate by correlating the indices of prefixes that saw eviction vs nodes that were torn down.

maya: mitigation status: hit-rate and error rates improving; p95 latency trending down. CS notified impacted customers. Keeping incident open for RCA.

alex.m: action item list for RCA thread:
- collect per-customer impact windows and request traces (alex.m)
- repro and patch prefix-sync serializer (jen)
- propose autoscaler hysteresis changes to avoid reacting to transient churn (ricardo)
- produce timeline with logs and annotated hypotheses (sam)

cust-success-bot: Support tickets updated; customers notified with incident ref INC-2026-0315-57.

maya: handing off to postmortem owners. I'll lead RCA doc draft. Please drop any remaining artifacts in the logs link and label timeline entries with the hypothesis number. Good run folks :thumbsup:

sam: snapshotting timeline at 16:18:30Z and uploading to postmortem folder: https://pm.redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0315-57/timeline

ricardo: marking H1 primary pending autoscaler correlation. I'll update with evidence by EOD.

jen: will open a PR with serializer fix and a test to ensure absent ttl != 0.

maya: incident transitioned to post-incident RCA tracking. Closing live mitigation messages.
